name: What materials are commonly used for luxury terrace surfaces?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for luxury terrace surfaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: For luxury terraces, popular materials often include natural stone like travertine, slate, or bluestone for their elegance and durability. High-quality porcelain pavers offer versatility in design and low maintenance. Premium hardwoods such as ipe or teak provide a warm, sophisticated look. Recycled or engineered materials are also selected for their sustainability and modern aesthetics, ensuring both beauty and longevity suitable for an urban outdoor luxury setting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common luxury terrace materials include natural stone (travertine, slate), porcelain pavers, premium hardwoods (ipe, teak), and engineered materials.
